svg.title: Engineering capability matrix
svg.desc: Capabilities grouped into five areas, each paired with the project that demonstrates it. AI / MACHINE LEARNING: PyTorch + Hugging Face (Morph, Lane study); Knowledge distillation (Morph); Browser inference (ONNX, WebGPU) (TalonCV); Speech: Whisper, TTS, STT (TalonCV, AILA); Vision: YOLO, MediaPipe, OpenCV (TalonCV, OBSERV-E); NLP + embeddings (TalonCV, ConfusionClassifier); LLM / VLM integration (OBSERV-E, AILA). AUTONOMY / ROBOTICS: Sensor fusion (cam/radar/LiDAR) (EcoCAR); RTMaps real-time pipelines (EcoCAR); Kalman filtering + tracking (OBSERV-E); Reinforcement learning (PPO) (RL sim); Lane perception (Lane study); Requirements + validation (EcoCAR); Hardware integration (BLE, serial) (OBSERV-E). SOFTWARE ENGINEERING: Python · TypeScript · C++ (across repos); Next.js · React (TalonCV, LEAD-AI); FastAPI (ConfusionClassifier, Certeverin); Web Workers + IndexedDB (TalonCV); Testing: Vitest, Playwright, pytest (TalonCV); Godot 4 / GDScript (Cloud Conglomerate); Streamlit tooling (TalonCV, TTP). CLOUD / INFRASTRUCTURE: Supabase: Postgres, RLS, Edge Fns (CampGrids); AWS IaC: CloudFormation, Cognito, RDS (CampGrids); Neon Postgres + Drizzle (LEAD-AI, ITR Lab); Vercel serverless + static export (TalonCV, AILA); GitHub Actions CI (TalonCV); Azure Speech / Cognitive Services (OfficePro); GPU capacity + cost modeling (Compute Collab.). RESEARCH / OPTIMIZATION: Experiment grids + ablations (Lane study); Dev-only model selection (ConfusionClassifier); Calibration + log-loss (ConfusionClassifier); Quantization (4/8-bit, q4/q8) (Morph, TalonCV); CPU pipeline benchmarking (TalonCV, OBSERV-E); Reproducibility + provenance (Morph, ConfusionClassifier); Explainability (TalonCV, ConfusionClassifier).
svg.text: What I build with, and where you can see it
Every capability links to a project. No skill bars, no self-ratings.
